blocking_reason: The staging bidirectional release rollback, immutable database/object recovery, authenticated isolated application recovery smoke, and measured RPO/RTO objectives passed. The recovery target was local Docker beside a single-node staging source rather than a verified independent production-like fault domain, and no independent reviewer has signed off, so the overall recovery gate remains open.
prerequisites: Provision a separately named recovery target outside the active single-node staging fault domain
Assign an independent reviewer who is not the drill operator
Repeat the production-like recovery drill on that target, meet both approved objectives, and obtain reviewer sign-off
required_evidence: Application and data smoke after restore
